LESSON: WHO IS CREATION

Grade: PP1
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: GOD’S
Topic 1.1: Who is CREATION

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Who is CREATION
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Where does He live?
